source_review.notes: Checked all eight sources for identity, authority, currency or publication date, and bounded claim scope. Google SRE sources support user-relevant signals, objective-led monitoring, and symptom/cause separation. Current Grafana documentation supports question-first, cognitive-load, like-for-like, hierarchy, documentation, refresh, and governance claims as vendor guidance. WCAG 2.2 supports accessibility claims, and RFC 3339 supports timestamp representation limitations. Checked 2026-09-06.
